package consumer

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationfixture/blog"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationfixture/project"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
)

func misuse() {
	relations, _ := project.BindReverseRelations()
	var wrong orm.Predicate[blog.Post] = relations.AuthorsAuthor.Posts.Title.Exact("Alpha")
	_ = wrong
}
